Helpful information

Frequently asked questions

Do you provide car and two-wheeler training?

Yes, this website lists both car driving and two-wheeler training. Contact the school to confirm current availability.

How much does the course cost?

Fees and schedules should be confirmed directly with the school. Use WhatsApp or the enquiry form to ask for current details.

Is car training available for both men and women?

Yes. Car driving training is offered for both male and female learners.

Can women learn scooty riding with a female instructor?

Women can enquire about scooty training with a female instructor. Please confirm available slots when contacting the school.

Are the fees affordable and timings flexible?

Contact the school to discuss affordable course options and comfortable lesson timings that fit your schedule.

What should I bring before starting?

Please contact the school first to confirm the current document requirements, learner eligibility and anything you should bring for your first lesson.

Can a complete beginner enquire?

Yes. Tell the school you are a beginner so the course details can be discussed with you.

Can I upload my own photos and videos?

This demo includes a local preview tool. Public uploads require an online admin upload system and media storage.
